notes: Card balance overhaul — new mechanics, buffed Legendaries, reworked Sponsor, and expanded deck limits.
features: COPY LIMITS EXPANDED — Legendaries now allow 3 copies per deck (up from 2). Platinums, Signature Platinums, and Signature Golds now allow 2 copies per deck (up from 1). Epics remain at 3.

PHOENIX RISING REDESIGNED — Now a 1-cost 1/1. When destroyed, it gets back up at the start of your next turn at +1/+1 (1/1 → 2/2 → … → 10/10). At 10/10 it falls permanently. Cannot return if banished or transformed. Its death triggers a golden upward dissolve instead of the usual crumple.

TURNING POINT — New Purpose Legendary (3-cost, 2/4). On Play: if your leader has less defense than the enemy, draw 2 cards and gain 1 maximum PP. Otherwise draw 1. A comeback tool that rewards playing from behind.

PURPOSE ETERNAL RECLASSIFIED — Rarity changed from Legendary to Epic, meaning you can now run up to 3 copies. Ability upgraded from Charge to Charge-Storm — it attacks immediately and pierces through a full enemy board.
VOICE OF REASSURANCE REWORKED — Cost reduced from 9 to 3. On Play: draw 2 cards, then reduce the cost of the 2 most expensive cards in hand by 1 each.
PEACE BEYOND FEAR REWORKED — Cost reduced from 9 to 7. On Play: restore 5 defense, draw a card, and Exhaust all enemy followers so they cannot attack next turn.
HOPE UNENDING BUFFED — Cost reduced from 9 to 7. Stats adjusted to 5/8 (from 7/11). Same heal-and-draw effect, now available two turns earlier.

THE SPONSOR BUFFED — Arrival now summons 2 Sponsees immediately (up from 1). Still summons 1 more at the end of each of your turns. All Sponsees are now 3/3 base (up from 2/2). Courage Sponsees are 4/3 with Charge; Hope Sponsees are 3/5; Serenity Sponsees are 3/5 with Guard; Purpose Sponsees are 3/3 and grant 2 Progress on entry (up from 1). Sponsee death heals updated: Hope restores 5, Serenity 3, Courage 2.

SPONSOR TRIAL CINEMATIC — Battling The Sponsor now opens a dedicated cinematic intro: a dark fade-in, the message 'Someone has been watching your progress...', The Sponsor's portrait emerging with a golden glow, his name, and his quote before the battlefield loads.
upcoming_events: More seasonal content and cards are in development — check back after future updates for details.
